question.problem: Find the value of $x - \dfrac{3}{2}y$ when $x=2$ and $y=-2.$
question.worked_solution:
Replacing $x$ with $2$ and $y$ with $-2$ in the expression, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x-\frac{3}{2}y & = \\ 2-\frac{3}{2}\cdot (-2) & = \\ 2+(-\frac{3}{2})\cdot (-2) & = \\ 2+3 & = \\ 5.\end{aligned}
$$
